title: US Sanctions Rwandan Defence Ministry After US-Facilitated DRC-Rwanda Military Talks in Germany
detail: US-facilitated DRC-Rwanda military planning talks in Germany sought to finalize a draft operations order for joint security efforts and Rwandan military disengagement under the Trump-backed eastern DRC plan. Per reports on Oct 28, the US Treasury then sanctioned Rwanda's Ministry of Defence and Zigama Credit and Savings Society over alleged support for M23.

title: UN Libya Envoy Chairs Third Smaller Convening Follow-Up on 30 August Agreement
detail: On Oct 28 UN Special Representative Hanna Tetteh chaired the third follow-up meeting of the Smaller Convening, reviewing implementation of the 30 August Agreement with a focus on unifying the judiciary ahead of elections.
